summary: xAI released 21 new multilingual voices for Grok Voice, available in the Voice Agent API, Text to Speech API and a new Grok Voice Agent Builder, alongside retrained versions of the original five voices for improved naturalness.

practices.reason: Expanded and improved voice output is a multimodal capability addition but not tied to a core dimension most engineering teams optimize for.
practices.quote: Ara, Eve, Leo, Rex, and Sal got an upgrade alongside the new voices. They've been retrained with an improved recipe, so pacing, phrasing, and emphasis are more natural.

practices.reason: New voices and a voice agent builder add optional API surface but require no mandatory migration.
practices.quote: All of them are multilingual and available now in the realtime Voice Agent API , the Text to Speech API , and the new Grok Voice Agent Builder .
